Video.summary: Follow Team Chaos's journey. From humble beginnings to how they ended up building one of the most feared Robots ever to compete.
Video.title: Ultimate Collection: Chaos 2

Video.summary: More behind the scenes of the hit series Robot Wars. Philippa gets into the nitty gritty of why competitors choose to compete.

Video.summary: The undercover secrets and un-muzzled action of Robot Wars, see how competitors prepare their robots for victory, or defeat.
Video.title: Revealed - Episode 7

Video.summary: See what happens when little kids become big kids, and toy trains are replaced by chainsaws. Watch the teams as they lock themselves in their workshops, creating killing machines.
Video.title: Revealed - Episode 8

Video.summary: Delving behind the trenches of Robot Wars, digging for dirt in the competitors own video diaries.
Video.title: Revealed - Episode 9

Video.summary: A unique, undercover look at Robot Wars Series 2. Featuring exclusive footage from the teams and highlights from the battles.

Video.summary: The Sixth Wars champions return to the arena to battle for the Seventh Wars title. Do they still have what it takes to win, or will the competition be too fierce this time round?
Video.title: The Seventh Wars - Heat E

Video.summary: A newcomer from Germany joins the UK competitors in this week’s heats. Will they put show the UK how it’s done, or will the other robots have a home advantage?
Video.title: The Seventh Wars - Heat F

Video.summary: Another German joins the roster this week. One robot becomes an eviction technician, removing their opponents from the arena. Refbot joins the fray as he helps pit an immobilised robot.
Video.title: The Seventh Wars - Heat G

Video.summary: A robot representing the Netherlands fights with the Brits in this heat. After attempting to attack one of the house robots, Growler makes an example of one of the competitors. Matilda uses her flywheel in spectacular fashion.
Video.title: The Seventh Wars - Heat H

Video.summary: One hapless robot gets expertly dismantled by another competitor, leaving Refbot to count them out. Maybe the house robots should take notes. A Hail Mary charge leaves yet another robot out of the arena.
Video.title: The Seventh Wars - Heat I

Video.summary: The Seventh Wars continues, eight more robots with high hopes of becoming champion enter the arena. One robot has to see a man about a dog, as Mr. Psycho and Growler team up on a competitor.
Video.title: The Seventh Wars - Heat J

Video.summary: The sixth Pinball warrior run introduces another competitor to test their skills against the targets, and the house robots. In the knockouts, the house robots are being exploited as the competitors over-crowd the CPZ zones.
Video.title: The Third Wars - Heat K

Video.summary: We see more teams from around the UK bringing in their unique, sometimes amusing, sometimes terrifying robots to battle against each other. Sergeant Bash’s flamethrower is put to good use in the knockouts.
Video.title: The Third Wars - Heat L

Video.summary: Walker Battle returns as the contestants for this week’s special prepare to put their best foot forward against the other legged robots. A competitor makes the house robots sweat in the knockouts.
Video.title: The Third Wars - Heat M

Video.summary: Pinball Warrior is back for the eighth time this series and the heats are nearing their end. One of the competitors uses its speed to great effect.
Video.title: The Third Wars - Heat N

Video.summary: The penultimate Pinball Warrior run is this week. The house robots risk their own metal to attack the competitors.
Video.title: The Third Wars - Heat O

Video.summary: The last heats of The Third Wars, as the finals approach, desperation grows among the competitors to secure a place in the finals. As well as the final heat, this episode features the final Pinball Warrior run of the third series.
Video.title: The Third Wars - Heat P

Video.summary: Karma comes for one of the competitors as the Semi-Finals commence in spectacular fashion. There are no specials this week as the knockout battles take priority in deciding who will win the crown.
Video.title: The Third Wars - Semi Final 1

Video.summary: More heat winners are pitted against each other in knockout competition. The robots attempt to ram, flip and burn their way to the finals, all while trying to avoid the house robots.
Video.title: The Third Wars - Semi Final 2

Video.summary: This is what it’s been building up to, The Grand Final is here. Which of the successful semi-finalists will be crowned champion of Robot Wars: The Third Wars?
Video.title: The Third Wars - Grand Final

Video.summary: Initially released on VHS and broadcast on TV a year later, the World Championship featured sixteen robots from eleven different countries. A straight knockout competition would decide which robot would be known as the World Champion.
Video.title: The Third Wars - First World Championship

Video.summary: The first of sixteen Heats in the seventh series. The four-way melees kick off the competition with true carnage. Sir Killalot may have changed the tide of battle during the finals.
Video.title: The Seventh Wars - Heat A

Video.summary: The second round of heats sees eight new robots join the fight for The Seventh Wars title. Growler is de-muzzled as he rampages through the arena in the four-way melees, no-one is safe.
Video.title: The Seventh Wars - Heat B

Video.summary: After the four-way melees, the house robots do not hesitate to get involved with the remaining competitors. A counter-attack leads to one of the shortest finals robot wars has ever seen.
Video.title: The Seventh Wars - Heat C

Video.summary: An equal number of newcomers and veterans take to the battlefield in this episode, experience versus vigor in today’s heats. The innocent Refbot gets attacked after cease is called.
Video.title: The Seventh Wars - Heat D
